subjectOutcomes.name: Emerald Gardens International School

subjectOutcomes.name: HIS International School

subjectOutcomes.name: Hua Xia International School
subjectOutcomes.note: Second review: official navigation still offers Early Years and Secondary only. A 2019 prospectus surfaced but was not used as evidence of current primary provision or subjects.

subjectOutcomes.name: Reed International School
subjectOutcomes.note: Second review: official Rawang recruitment advert names languages and Global Perspectives without identifying teaching years. It cannot substantiate a primary-only subject list. Main-site direct access failed; Seri Kembangan material was not copied to Rawang.

subjectOutcomes.name: SAINT International School
subjectOutcomes.note: Second review: official curriculum, downloads and public pages reviewed. The triangular model combines primary and secondary with arts/technology activities; it does not establish a primary timetable. Broad teacher/internship degree requirements were not treated as taught subjects.
